roles.title: Software Developer Intern
roles.description: Packaged an AI assisted chatbot component for easier installation within the Meridian npm package (UCSD developer package). Developed prompt engineering and Python tooling so Meridian users can dynamically generate customized UI components from chat prompts. Built full stack demo applications integrating Meridian with React and Next.js to exercise data binding and custom UI generation. Contributed developer feedback in design meetings that shaped upcoming Meridian features.

roles.title: Data Analyst Intern
roles.description: Integrated data visualization into an existing Python pipeline for graphical views of neural signals. Processed gigabytes of neural data through MEAnap, oscillation, and spike sorting workflows. Built a Next.js application that converts raw data into processed outputs formatted for roughly 2x faster analysis in Prism. Used Prism for two-way ANOVA graphs. Debugged and set up virtual environments so colleagues can run processing scripts reliably.

roles.title: Programming Instructor & Event Coordinator
roles.description: Built the NGYL website with HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to grow awareness, roughly double volunteer sign ups, and support mission and event communication. Organized a STEM career seminar with four industry professionals and over 200 participants. Taught 300+ students across Python, drone robotics, Lego robotics, and machine learning.
